provenance: Hackathon-scoped, answer-key-independent task definition. It intentionally narrows the product-scale V1 catalog to 24 objective, configuration-specific enthusiast facts. The original V1 catalog remains immutable under evals/task_definition/v1_objective_field_catalog.json.

fields.description: Audio-system amplifier rated output in watts; return a numeric objective value only when the exact configuration is supported.
Whether the exact vehicle configuration includes a dedicated subwoofer; boolean only.
Structured brake-rotor profile object: {front_diameter_in: number|null, rear_diameter_in: number|null}. Keep front and rear separate; do not flatten to prose.
Structured default-tire object: {brand_model: string|null, size: string|null}. This is the listed/tested default tire for the exact configuration, not an aftermarket recommendation.
Instrumented 70-to-0 mph braking distance in feet for the matching configuration. Prefer Car and Driver when available.
Whether the exact vehicle configuration has adaptive cruise control; boolean only.

Whether adaptive cruise can operate in stop-and-go traffic, including braking to a complete stop and resuming/continuing according to the defined system behavior. Do not equate simple braking-to-zero with this field.
Whether the exact vehicle configuration provides continuous active lane-centering steering assistance. Do not substitute lane-departure warning or momentary lane-keeping correction.
Exact listed/tested drivetrain layout: FWD, RWD, AWD, or 4WD.
Whether the exact vehicle configuration has a limited-slip differential. This is not rear-axle-specific.
Engine displacement in liters as a numeric value for combustion or hybrid powertrains; use not_applicable where no combustion engine exists.
Engine aspiration: naturally aspirated, turbocharged, supercharged, or explicit not_applicable for pure EVs.
Exact-configuration horsepower as a numeric value in hp; distinguish engine and combined-system output where applicable.
Exact-configuration maximum torque as a numeric value in lb-ft; distinguish engine and combined-system torque where applicable.
Exact-configuration curb weight in pounds; retain the source's configuration dependency when present.
Deterministic curb_weight_lb / horsepower result, rounded to two decimals. The model must not research this field.
Instrumented 0-to-60 mph result in seconds for the matching configuration; prefer Car and Driver when available.
Instrumented lateral acceleration in g for the matching configuration; prefer Car and Driver when available.
Conditional structured energy-storage object: {fuel_tank_gal: number|null, battery_kwh: number|null}. ICE uses fuel_tank_gal; EV uses battery_kwh; PHEV may contain both. Do not combine units.

Transmission mechanism: manual, torque-converter automatic, DCT, CVT/IVT, single-speed EV reduction gear, or another supported mechanism. Generic provider text saying Automatic is insufficient to claim a mechanism.
Forward gear count where applicable. State not_applicable only when the frozen semantics support it; do not invent simulated ratios for a CVT.
Whether an automatic transmission provides driver-selected manual shifting from the console/gear selector; boolean only.
Whether steering-wheel paddle shifters are present for the exact vehicle configuration; boolean only.
Structured suspension-layout object: {front: string|null, rear: string|null}. Keep front and rear separate even if the UI renders one summary.
